publishedGuide.rowText:
POST /auth/openai 
 URL-encoded form or JSON  {csrf,intent:"signin"} ;  intent  may be  signin ,  link  or  reauthenticate . Link requires recent current-account verification; reauthenticate accepts only an already linked identity of the current account and rotates its cookie. Starts the matching anonymous/signed-in flow and redirects to the official authorization endpoint in the new window.

diagnostics.finding: Literal pipe characters in the Markdown intent enum truncated the generated HTTP table row. Explicit prose lists all three intents; actual generated HTML is checked before final sealing.
TypeScript identified a test closure narrowing and unused browser import; both corrected before the successful build.
Successful deletion displayed both progress and success status elements; an ambiguous test locator failed. A specific success-message assertion fixed the test without changing product behavior.

coverageLimits: Signed fixtures are not live OpenAI acceptance; no registered client/callback or partner account was fabricated.
Reverification uses a new verified code/nonce exchange and does not force password/MFA in OpenAI.
Account deletion is logical; transient hashed markers expire after ten minutes and prune on the next request. SQLite pages/WAL/backups are not forensically erased.
Source artwork/history/recovery/projects and separately granted document/plugin connections are deliberately independent of account identity.
No provider inference, plan scope, original image upload, deployment, outreach, REST synchronization or new isolated capability is added.
A single shared private SQLite database is supported, not unrelated distributed databases. Node 24.0.1 SQLite emits an experimental-feature warning.
Exact synthetic 50 MP output does not establish physical photographic fidelity, peak memory, universal device acceptance or sustained 60fps.
The full original roadmap goal remains active.
